data.name: Vulnerable to Smoke
data.description: Smoke from particularly smoky fires or effects (such as that created by a pyrotechnics spell) causes a giant bee to become nauseated if it fails a DC 14 Fortitude save.  This condition persists as long as the giant bee remains in the smoke, plus 1d4 rounds.
